title: staehelinia alpina

It is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which can aid in relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Staehelinia alpina are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, which exhibit antibacterial and antioxidant properties, and furanocoumarins, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antiviral effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of Staehelinia alpina, but its traditional use as a medicinal plant suggests its value in promoting overall well-being.
